_note: Kawasemi-yu, the public bath in Yumachi, inside: the lobby (2026-11-22, Baths step 2; docs/DESIGN.md → ที่อาบน้ำ). One bath for everyone in bathing towels (the user's pick: the farmer has no set gender). A packed-earth entry by the door with the shoe lockers, wooden floor, the counter (shop sento in data/shops.json: the milk; the 120 G entry was paid at the street door, Game.use_door), the milk cooler, two benches for cooling off. The clock stands still in here like in every building. Format: README.md, Maps.
